c1-20-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Why the Water Fell
c1-20-01.scenario: You and a friend read an article about drought on the sand ridge of the Alföld.
c1-20-01.prompt: Say what caused the groundwater to fall, and what happened to the harvest.
cues: Say what caused the fall of groundwater
Say what happened to the harvest
c1-20-01.target: A hosszú aszály következtében a talajvíz egyre mélyebben van. A csatornák építése nyomán sok kút kiszáradt.
c1-20-01.english: As a result of the long drought the groundwater is deeper and deeper. In the wake of building canals many wells dried up.
c1-20-01.canDo: I can name the cause of an ecological change in formal Hungarian (*következtében*, *folytán*, *nyomán*, *eredményeként*).

c1-20-02.title: Communicative Challenge: A Drained Landscape
c1-20-02.scenario: You and a friend look at photos of a drained floodplain on the Great Plain.
c1-20-02.prompt: Say what the marshes and the soil look like now.
c1-20-02.target: A mocsarak lecsapolva fekszenek az egykori ártéren. A talaj kiszáradva fekszik a nyári napon.
c1-20-02.english: The marshes lie drained on the former floodplain. The soil lies dried out in the summer sun.
c1-20-02.canDo: I can describe a damaged landscape with a *-va/-ve* participle (*kiszáradva fekszik*, *lecsapolva*).

c1-20-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Profit or Water
c1-20-03.scenario: You and a friend talk about irrigation on the Great Plain.
c1-20-03.prompt: Say that irrigation raises the harvest in the short run, but the drinking water must on no account be sacrificed.
cues: Say what must not be sacrificed
c1-20-03.target: Jóllehet az öntözés rövid távon növeli a termést, ennek dacára hosszú távon kimeríti a vizet. Az ivóvizet semmiképp sem szabad feláldozni.
c1-20-03.english: Although irrigation raises the harvest in the short run, despite this it uses up the water in the long run. The drinking water must on no account be sacrificed.
c1-20-03.canDo: I can set a short-term gain against a long-term cost (*Jóllehet …, ennek dacára …*, *Ámbár …, mégsem …*).

c1-20-04.title: Communicative Challenge: What If They Had Kept the Water
c1-20-04.scenario: You and a friend talk about river regulation in the 19th century.
c1-20-04.prompt: Say what would be different today if they had retained water in the landscape.
cues: Say what they could have done
Say what would be different today
c1-20-04.target: Ha vizet tartottak volna vissza a tájban, ma nem száradna ki ennyire az Alföld. Ha kevesebb mocsarat csapoltak volna le, ma több ivóvizünk lenne.
c1-20-04.english: If they had retained water in the landscape, the Great Plain would not be drying out so much today. If they had drained fewer marshes, we would have more drinking water today.
c1-20-04.canDo: I can say what would be different today if something had been done differently (*Ha … volna, ma nem …-na*).

c1-20-05.title: Communicative Challenge: Water Falling Fast
c1-20-05.scenario: You and a friend read the short text about Kaán Károly.
c1-20-05.prompt: Say how the groundwater and the forest area are changing on the Great Plain.
cues: Say how fast the groundwater falls
Say how the forest area changes
c1-20-05.target: A talajvíz szintje vészesen csökken. Az őshonos erdők területe fokozatosan zsugorodik az Alföldön.
c1-20-05.english: The groundwater level is falling alarmingly. The area of the native forests is shrinking gradually on the Great Plain.
c1-20-05.canDo: I can say how fast and how permanent a loss is (*vészesen*, *fokozatosan*, *szemlátomást*, *visszafordíthatatlanul*).

c1-20-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Talking About the Alföld
c1-20-consolidation.scenario: You and a friend talk about what you read in this unit.
c1-20-consolidation.prompt: Say that the river regulation changed the water balance, and what Kaán Károly suggested for the Great Plain.
c1-20-consolidation.target: A folyók szabályozása nyomán az Alföld vízháztartása megváltozott. Kaán Károly az Alföld fásítását javasolta.
c1-20-consolidation.english: As a result of river regulation the water balance of the Great Plain changed. Kaán Károly suggested afforesting the Great Plain.
c1-20-consolidation.canDo: I can talk about drought, drained land and the cost to nature in Hungarian.
